```yaml
name: Desktop Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: |
            github.com
            api.github.com
            registry.npmjs.org
            crates.io
            proxy.golang.org
            raw.githubusercontent.com
          egress-policy: block
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true

      - name: Block unauthorized outbound traffic
        uses: bullfrogsec/bullfrog@1831f79cce8ad602eef14d2163873f27081ebfb3
        with:
          allowed-domains: |
            github.com
            api.github.com
            registry.npmjs.org
            crates.io
            proxy.golang.org
            raw.githubusercontent.com
          egress-policy: block
          enable-sudo: false

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-

      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --verbose

      - name: Run Rust clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: TypeScript type check
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

      - name: Run Vitest
        run: npx vitest run

      - name: Build Rust binary (release)
        run: cargo build --workspace --release

      - name: Prepare desktop release artifact
        env:
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/release/clawdstrike dist/
          tar -czf clawdstrike-desktop-${REF_NAME}.tar.gz -C dist clawdstrike

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clawdstrike-desktop
          path: clawdstrike-desktop-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz

  release:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clawdstrike-desktop
          path: .

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: clawdstrike-desktop-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz
          generate_release_notes: true
```
